title: Why Summer Visitors Become High Country Buyers
excerpt: Every summer, thousands of visitors fall in love with the Blue Ridge Mountains — and a surprising number of them start asking real estate questions before they leave. If you've ever sat on a porch in Boone and thought 'I could live here,' you're not alone.
